verdict.rationale: Muse ships an official mobile app. An Apple App Store listing ('Muse from Meta') describes a feature-rich client with linked accounts, action approvals and background notifications, and the homepage says to chat 'using the Muse app on mobile, Mac, or directly in WhatsApp.' Nothing in the pack names an Android app or a Play Store listing, so only iOS is evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an official Android app, evidence that the mobile apps match the full feature set of other clients, and independent hands-on corroboration of the mobile experience.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can use full-featured official mobile apps for iOS and Android

citations.quote: Chat with your agent in the same way you message with other people, using the Muse app on mobile, Mac, or directly in WhatsApp.
You decide what Muse can access. Link your email, calendar, Instagram, Facebook, health and fitness data, and finances. Approve actions before they happen.
Muse keeps things moving after you close the app. It monitors, follows up, and sends a notification when something needs your attention
